title: EZ Solderless N Type Male Plug Connector for LMR300 5D-FB RG6 Coaxial Cable, 50 Ohm RF Clamp Connector, No Crimp Tool
description_html:
EZ Solderless N Type Male Plug Connector is a straight, cable-mount 50 Ohm RF connector for LMR300, 5D-FB and RG6 coaxial cables. The clamp-style body compresses the braid with a tail nut and rubber gasket, so no crimp tool or soldering is required.

Key Features

  • N Type male plug, straight cable-mount design
  • Solderless clamp / compression termination
  • Nickel-plated brass body with gold-plated brass center contact
  • PTFE insulator and rubber gasket
  • Compatible with LMR300, 5D-FB and RG6 cables
  • Compact 42.1 mm overall length, 8.1 mm maximum diameter
  • 5/8-24 UNEF-2B coupling thread

Specifications

Connector TypeN Type male plug
Impedance50 Ohm
Frequency RangeDC - 18 GHz
VSWR≤1.25:1 typical
Body MaterialNickel-plated brass
Center ContactGold-plated brass
InsulatorPTFE
TerminationSolderless clamp / nut compression
Cable CompatibilityLMR300 / 5D-FB / RG6
Thread5/8-24 UNEF-2B
Overall Length42.1 mm
Maximum Diameter8.1 mm

Applications

Antenna feeders, RF cable assemblies, wireless communication systems, telecom equipment, test instruments and other 50 Ohm coaxial connections.

Installation

Prepare the cable, slide on the tail nut and gasket, insert the cable into the body, then tighten the tail nut to compress the braid. No soldering iron, flux or crimp tool is required.

Package Contents

1 x N Type male connector, 1 x clamp ring, 1 x gasket, 1 x washer, 1 x tail nut.

Customization

OEM and ODM orders are welcome. Custom plating, cable groups and private labeling are available on request.
